question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**importance**" means the state or fact of being of great significance or value. (महत्त्व)
 
• The term &‘silk routes’ points to the historical significance of transporting Chinese silk westwards through these routes.
 
• The other options: "**emphasis**," "**consequence**," and "**insignificance**" do not fit the context as precisely.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The name ‘silk routes’ points to the importance__ of Westbound Chinese silk cargoes along this route.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Emphasis (जोर, बल)**: means special importance or significance placed on something.
 
• **Consequence (परिणाम)**: means a result or effect of an action or condition.
 
• **Insignificance (महत्त्वहीनता)**: means the quality of being too small or unimportant to be worth consideration.
